about_the_game:
Momo & Dodo: MODO Card Mayhem!

Momo and Dodo are superstar streamers from the Demon Realm. During a routine broadcast, a mysterious network disruption forcibly ended their stream and plunged every demon into violent madness. The sisters then received an email from the enigmatic "Dr. M," who entrusted them with a powerful card deck – the MODO Cards. Now, wielding these magical cards, they must battle through live streams to save their frenzied fans and fellow demons! As they investigate the network chaos, they begin to uncover shocking truths about their world...

Game Features:
◆ Hybrid 2D/3D Rogue-lite Card Battles: A lighthearted fusion of strategic deckbuilding and chaotic fun!
◆ Dual Protagonists: Play as energetic Momo or tactical Dodo in streamer-style combat.
◆ Save & Convert: Rescue enraged demons and turn them into loyal fans!
◆ Dynamic Combat: Summon magical crystals (your weapons!) using MODO Cards during live-stream battles.
◆ Between Streams: Upgrade your gear at the shop to enhance your broadcast impact.
◆ Unravel Mysteries: Piece together the truth behind the Demon Realm's corruption through investigative gameplay.

Story-Driven Adventure:
Each chapter features specially produced story cutscenes – we encourage you to watch them all! Forge your own path through strategic card synergies and discover multiple endings.

Call for Collaborations!
We welcome feedback, suggestions, and partnership opportunities! We're open to collaborations and will feature your original characters (OCs), VTubers, or game characters in our game – completely free!
